classification.difficultyReason: Combine parallel-line angle properties with vertically opposite angles, triangle angle sums and an auxiliary parallel line.

content.prompt: Find $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\theta$ in each diagram, giving reasons.

spec.description: Two triangles meet at A, with the left and right triangles on opposite sides of A. Matching single arrows mark BC parallel to QP; Q has a right-angle square.
spec.mathematics: B,A,Q are collinear; C,A,P are collinear; BC is parallel to QP; PAQ=30 degrees; AQP=90 degrees. Alpha is BAC, beta is ABC and gamma is BCA.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=30^{\circ}$ (vertically opposite angles at $A$).

$\beta=90^{\circ}$ (alternate angles, $BC\parallel QP$).

Using the angle sum of $\triangle ABC$:
$$\begin{align*}\gamma&=180^{\circ}-30^{\circ}-90^{\circ}\\\gamma&=60^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram DABC with single parallel arrows on DA and CB, double parallel arrows on DC and AB, and the source angle labels retained at their actual vertices.
spec.mathematics: D is upper left, A upper right, B lower right and C lower left. D=115 degrees; alpha is at A, beta at B and gamma at C.
spec.answerVisibility: No calculated angle values are supplied.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines are supplementary.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=180^{\circ}-115^{\circ}\\\alpha&=65^{\circ}\\\beta&=180^{\circ}-65^{\circ}\\\beta&=115^{\circ}\\\gamma&=180^{\circ}-115^{\circ}\\\gamma&=65^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
For $\alpha$, use $DC\parallel AB$ with transversal $DA$; for $\beta$, use $DA\parallel CB$ with transversal $AB$; for $\gamma$, use $DA\parallel CB$ with transversal $DC$.

spec.description: F,G,H lie on one sloping line. FI and GJ are parallel horizontal segments joined by IJ. The right-angle mark is at J and alpha lies below GJ.
spec.mathematics: GFI=110 degrees; GJI=90 degrees; alpha=HGJ and beta=FIJ.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=110^{\circ}$ (corresponding angles, $FI\parallel GJ$).

Using co-interior angles on $FI\parallel GJ$:
$$\begin{align*}\beta&=180^{\circ}-90^{\circ}\\\beta&=90^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Open zigzag K-L-M-N-O, with KL parallel to ON. L is above and right of M; N is right of M; K and O lie to the left of their respective parallel segments.
spec.mathematics: KLM=50 degrees, MNO=20 degrees and theta=LMN. Matching single arrows mark KL parallel to ON.
spec.answerVisibility: The auxiliary parallel line needed in the solution is absent from the question diagram.

answer.short:
$\theta=70^{\circ}$.

Draw a parallel through $M$ to split $\theta$ into $50^{\circ}$ and $20^{\circ}$.
answer.worked:
Draw ray $MX$ through $M$, parallel to $KL$ and $ON$, with $X$ inside $\angle LMN$.

$\angle LMX=50^{\circ}$ (alternate angles, $MX\parallel KL$).

$\angle XMN=20^{\circ}$ (alternate angles, $MX\parallel ON$).

Adding adjacent angles at $M$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=50^{\circ}+20^{\circ}\\\theta&=70^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
